_comment: Sample run config for gen-prompts.py --group shared --families SH-PW (shared tenant ct-zinc-master on CT, review fix F-05, 2026-10-27). One config per shared family: the engine has one tenant per config, and each family runs on another shared tenant (group.json env.tenants). Run sample01 and the paths are fakes; ANTBE = the embedding mock user named in group.json (login name only, id n/a). Supplied by the runner, fake here: PIDOPS_PROFILE and PORTAL_PROFILE (headed ops sign-ins for this stage, outside results/). CRED_FILE stays none: the operator types antbe's login in the iframe. bundle / bundle_class n/a unless the shared box's bundle is known. Launch only after SH-G1 (owners' consent) and P-PTN-10. Test: gen-prompts.py <this file> --group shared --families SH-PW --dry-run (exit 0, no NEEDS CONFIG line).
